objective: Test the owner's picture of anchors in the program's terms. On a registered exhaustive census of small starts and on named families, under ordinary growth and the added rules: which starts return while parts come apart, with and without dead knots; whether the part that returns is always made of knots that waited and whether any law without waiting returns; and whether a knot's own holdings give the round it was made in on rings with leftover distinctions and on the seven-knot generator. First discriminator: the smallest returning start with every knot live against the smallest with a dead knot. Stop when every frozen prediction has a verdict.
title: What a reference is: joining through a dead knot, the knots that wait, and reading the round from one knot
